title: Documentation Generation

body.text: Have the AI write the docs nobody wants to write:
README, API docs, comments, and architecture overviews
— Codex reads the real code and summarizes it accurately, because the docs are based on the current code, not someone's memory.

example: "Write a new README: how to install, run the project, the folder structure, and the env variables to set, based on the real code"

title: Living documentation

body.text: Docs die because no one updates them — fix that by
tying doc updates to every task that changes behavior
. For example, add to AGENTS.md: 'if you change the API, update the docs too,' and the AI will do it every time.

example: "Add a rule to AGENTS.md: every new endpoint must have a request/response example in docs/api.md"
